description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Importation of Fish
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a regulatory matter under the Special Commodity Levy Act, where the Minister is making an order to modify levy rates on imported fish. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, the core content is about legal/regulatory changes to import duties and levy collection, not about government personnel changes or structural reorganization. The document constitutes a statutory instrument under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
